title: Establish dependency resolution playbook for PRD ambiguity and legal review lanes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: create a lightweight, repeatable playbook that clarifies PRD acceptance lanes and resolves cross-team questions (engineering, design, legal) within predictable SLAs. This ticket captures the playbook, the escalation ladder, template checklists for each discipline, and a small pilot with 2 upcoming PRDs.

Background: Over the last two cycles several PRDs stalled for >10 business days due to scope ambiguity (prompt routing), unknown telemetry contracts, and inconsistent legal data residency asks. That drift causes delayed releases and rework in runtime/console teams.

Deliverables:
- Playbook doc (Confluence link) with staging lanes: Triage -> Scoped Clarify -> Design QA -> Legal Check -> Final Acceptance.
- Discipline checklists (Design, Eng, Legal) with explicit acceptance artifacts (mockups, API contract, telemetry schema, dataflow diagram, signed risk exception if needed).
- SLA matrix: initial triage 48h, engineering clarification 5 business days, legal signoff 7 business days, total soft target 12 business days.
- Pilot run for PRD: "Telemetry opt-in for Shared Routes" (PRD link) and "Batching config UI" (PRD link).
- Owner rota and weekly sync template for the first 3 sprints.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Confluence playbook published and linked from PRD template.
2) All checklist items mapped to required artifacts; PRD template fields enforce those artifacts before assignment.
3) Pilot PRDs completed within SLA matrix and retrospective notes recorded with at least 3 concrete improvements.
4) Two training sessions (10–15 attendees) run for PMs, Eng leads, and Legal liaisons.

Success metrics (first quarter after rollout):
- Median PRD review time reduced from 11 days to <=6 days.
- Legal review reopen rate reduced by 40%.
- Fewer production changes caused by misunderstanding of telemetry (target reduction 30%).

Risks and trade-offs:
- Tight SLAs may push reviews to be superficial; mitigated by mandatory artifact gating.
- Legal bandwidth constraints; mitigation includes pre-approved template clauses and a rotating legal liaison.

Links & artifacts:
- Draft playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/PRD+Dependency+Playbook+Draft
- PRD (Telemetry opt-in): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/telemetry-prd-draft
- Pilot PRD (Batching UI): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/batching-ui-prd
- Sample checklist (Design): https://drive.redwood.ai/design/checklists/prd-design-checklist-v1.pdf
